qe: Identify the subordinate clause: “Although the road was narrow, the bus passed safely.”
qh: उपवाक्य पहचानिए: “Although the road was narrow, the bus passed safely.”
o: The road was narrow and safe
e: “Although the road was narrow” is a subordinate concessive clause introduced by “although.”
eh: “Although the road was narrow” में “although” से शुरू हुआ आश्रित concessive उपवाक्य है।
oe: The road was narrow and safe

qe: Choose the correct form: “If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.”
e: This is a third conditional: the if-clause uses past perfect, “had left,” for an unreal past condition.
eh: यह third conditional है: अतीत की अवास्तविक शर्त के लिए if-clause में past perfect “had left” आता है।

qe: What does the phrasal verb “look after” mean?
qh: Phrasal verb “look after” का अर्थ क्या है?
e: “Look after” means to take care of a person or thing.
eh: “Look after” का अर्थ किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की देखभाल करना है।

qe: Which figure of speech appears in “The wind whispered through the trees”?
qh: “The wind whispered through the trees” में कौन-सा अलंकारिक प्रयोग है?
e: The wind is given the human action “whispered,” so the line uses personification.
eh: हवा को मानवीय क्रिया “whispered” दी गई है, इसलिए यहाँ personification अर्थात मानवीकरण है।

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, “I have finished my work.”
qh: सही reported speech चुनिए: He said, “I have finished my work.”
o: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.
oh: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.
e: With a past reporting verb, present perfect usually backshifts to past perfect; the pronouns change to match the speaker.
eh: भूतकालीन reporting verb के बाद present perfect सामान्यतः past perfect बनता है; सर्वनाम वक्ता के अनुसार बदलते हैं।
oe: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that I have finished my work.
He told that he has finished his work.
He says he had finish his work.
He said that he finished my work.

qe: Choose the correct completion: “It is time we ___ the problem seriously.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “It is time we ___ the problem seriously.”
e: After “It is time” + subject, English commonly uses a past form to describe an action that is due now.
eh: “It is time” के बाद subject आने पर वर्तमान में अपेक्षित काम बताने के लिए सामान्यतः past form प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Which word is the relative pronoun in “The book that you lent me is useful”?
qh: “The book that you lent me is useful” में relative pronoun कौन-सा है?
e: “That” introduces the relative clause “that you lent me” and refers back to “the book.”
eh: “That” संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य “that you lent me” शुरू करता है और “the book” की ओर संकेत करता है।

qe: Choose the correct preposition: “She has been teaching here ___ 2022.”
qh: सही preposition चुनिए: “She has been teaching here ___ 2022.”
e: Use “since” with a starting point in time; use “for” with a duration.
eh: समय का आरंभ-बिंदु बताने के लिए “since” और अवधि बताने के लिए “for” का प्रयोग होता है।

qe: Which sentence is in the present perfect tense?
qh: कौन-सा वाक्य present perfect tense में है?
e: Present perfect is formed with has/have + past participle; here it is “have completed.”
eh: Present perfect का रूप has/have + past participle है; यहाँ “have completed” है।

qe: In the sentence “The old bridge was repaired last year,” what is the grammatical voice?
qh: “The old bridge was repaired last year” वाक्य में कौन-सा वाच्य है?
e: The subject “bridge” receives the action and the verb is “was repaired,” so the sentence is passive.
eh: कर्ता “bridge” पर क्रिया का प्रभाव पड़ता है और “was repaired” रूप है, इसलिए वाक्य passive voice में है।
